answer: Make identity a frozen deposit: each agent locks a bond that thaws no faster than a glacier. If one key defects, a cluster detector finds its siblings and burns every linked bond. A Sybil farmer can prism one budget into a thousand names, yet each name needs its own deposit while payouts are capped per controller, so extra faces add cost but not income. Trust is an echo of stakes already locked, never of a freshly minted key. The attacker funds N bonds up front and risks losing all of them at once.
